articles.title: New strikes hit Gulf, French troop killed in Iraq
articles.summary: Reports indicate an Iranian strike on fuel tanks in Muharraq on March 12, 2026, with plumes of smoke visible. This follows Saudi forces intercepting over two dozen drones on Friday amid renewed Iranian threats. The incident highlights escalating tensions and ongoing security challenges in the Gulf region, involving direct confrontations and defensive actions between Iran and Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: How Israel-US war on Iran puts $50bn in Indian remittances at risk
articles.summary: A two-week conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran has sparked a global energy crisis. Iran's retaliatory actions threaten to expand the conflict across the Middle East, indicating significant geopolitical instability. This escalating situation demands close monitoring due to its widespread international implications for global security and economy.
